descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S05 「每个平台的 release 传输设置：web bundle、iOS、Android」 Release transport settings per platform: web bundle, iOS, Android

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere.（UAT OAT-02；UAT 4；TFA-92568 AC 4；TFA-92568 Eng 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given The release artefacts of the UAT build: the production web bundle, the iOS archive's Info.plist and the Android release APK (merged manifest and network security config)

When Read the Convex URLs baked into each and its transport-security settings

Then Web: VITE_CONVEX_URL and VITE_CONVEX_SITE_URL are https://. iOS: no NSAllowsArbitraryLoads and no per-domain cleartext exception. Android release: usesCleartextTraffic=false, and the debug config (localhost, 127.0.0.1, 172.20.10.6) is not merged.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-02 step 1 'no plain HTTP endpoint anywhere'. A baked-in http:// endpoint (XML namespace URIs excluded), or a release setting that allows cleartext to a non-local host, = Fail. NSAllowsLocalNetworking is judged per Q6.

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：code-review。
